events.name: Fletchers' Family Farm at Christmas
events.description: In the wake of the fire that left their home uninhabitable, the Fletchers are determined to end the year on a brighter note and head to Austria on a snowy Alpine adventure. From the world-famous ski slopes of Hintertux, to the majestic forests of Soll, they journey into the heart of the Austrian Alps, discovering a farming culture rich in tradition. Staying with generational farmers Josef and Martina Achrainer and their extended family, the Fletchers experience true Alpine hospitality and learn why the mesmerising sound of cow bells are a traditional part of livestock handling, and even how to round up chickens using a chant
